messages:
alex: sec-ops, quick access request — need ephemeral admin to reproduce a crash on prod-worker-7. Will pull unredacted logs for up to 30m and run local redaction tests. Can we get break-glass for 30m? TL;DR: debug only, will upload scrubbed artifacts to secure bucket. @jen FYI.

sec-ops: pls provide exact scope (hosts/namespaces), justification, and observers. confirm you'll follow redaction checklist — no raw PII in unsecured storage.

alex: scope = namespace: prod-worker-7; pods: label app=worker; container: main. Justification: intermittent OOM/crash-loop we can't reproduce in staging. Observers: jen (security), mike (infra). Plan: run kubectl logs with --no-redact, capture stack traces, run redact script, upload redacted artifact. Will not keep raw copy in non-secure locations.

jen: I can shadow. make sure session is recorded and use the ephemeral token. :eyes: add the ticket once created.

infra-bot: Created access ticket INC-5421 — https://tickets.redwood/INC-5421 (auto) — awaiting sec-ops approval.

sec-ops: Approved for 30 minutes. Scope limited to pods with label app=worker in namespace prod-worker-7. Conditions: 1) session recording enabled, 2) no raw logs copied outside secure bucket, 3) run approved redaction script before sharing, 4) observers present. Break-glass token: BG-5421-EXPIRES-30M (use once). Infra will rotate creds after session.

mike: sgtm. I'll monitor and revoke if anything suspicious shows up.

alex: sample commands I'll run:
```bash
kubectl -n prod-worker-7 logs -l app=worker -c main --since=1h --no-redact > /tmp/worker-raw.log
python tools/redact.py --input /tmp/worker-raw.log --output /tmp/worker-redacted.log
gzip -c /tmp/worker-redacted.log > /tmp/worker-redacted.log.gz
aws s3 cp /tmp/worker-redacted.log.gz s3://redwood-secure/tmp/INC-5421/ --sse aws:kms --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/sec-audit
```
(Will not paste any tokens in channel.)

sec-ops: Reminder: set ACL=private and use the audit KMS key. Do not include raw file snapshots in ticket comments. We'll verify sample records offline. :white_check_mark:

alex: Using BG-5421-EXPIRES-30M to start session now. Starting logs pull, will ping when upload complete.

infra-bot: Session started by alex — session-id sess-19a2 (recording enabled).

alex: Done. Pulled logs, ran redaction, uploaded worker-redacted.log.gz to s3://redwood-secure/tmp/INC-5421/. Uploaded a small sample to the ticket (redacted). Kept the raw file on ephemeral instance only and removed after verification. Closing my window.

sec-ops: Received artifact, verifying quick sample. All good on first pass. Revoking token and closing break-glass now. Please follow up in the ticket with any additional artifacts.

infra-bot: Break-glass token BG-5421-EXPIRES-30M revoked. Session sess-19a2 archived. Ticket INC-5421 updated: status=closed. :lock:
